section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measurement of body pride using the Authentic Pride subscale of the Body and Appearance Self-Conscious Emotions Scale (BASES-AP), a 6-item instrument rated on a 5-point scale. The text reports that Cronbach's α for this subscale was .95 in both women and men, indicating strong internal consistency. No study-level demographic or outcome data are provided in this methods section.
